tools.name: assess_vault_readiness
tools.title: Assess vault technical readiness
tools.description: Evaluate WalletWall's published VAULT_TECHNICAL_READINESS rules 0.1.0-draft over an asset-identity assertion and a balance-at-block assertion. Returns CRITERIA_MET, CRITERIA_NOT_MET or NOT_ESTABLISHED with a per-criterion breakdown. It does not establish investment merit, solvency, creditworthiness, legal status, regulatory compliance, absence of fraud or future performance. Offline and read-only.

tools.name: check_invariants
tools.title: Check evidence invariants
tools.description: Check a WWEP 0.1 evidence bundle against the thirteen mandatory evidence invariants plus the rule that declared states must not exceed computed states. Returns violations by invariant ID and assertion ID. Offline and read-only.

tools.name: inspect_evidence
tools.title: Inspect evidence bundle
tools.description: Evaluate every assertion in a WWEP 0.1 evidence bundle against the bundled authority policies at the supplied evaluation time. Returns support, freshness and finality states, claim-specific authority, limitations, conflicts, supersession and digests. States describe how well the presented evidence satisfies policy; they do not verify that upstream evidence is true. Offline and read-only.

tools.name: normalize_observation
tools.title: Normalize balance observation
tools.description: Normalize a balance-at-block observation draft into a canonical WWEP observation. Validates atomic-unit decimal strings with BigInt, lowercases addresses and hashes, returns the RFC 8785 canonical JSON, SHA-256 evidence digest, content digest and exact decimal rendering. Offline and read-only; it does not fetch chain data.

tools.name: resolve_asset
tools.title: Resolve stablecoin deployment
tools.description: Look up a stablecoin deployment in the bundled WalletWall registry by chain ID and contract address, or list candidate deployments for a symbol. Offline and read-only. A registry match is a WalletWall-derived lookup without issuer attestation, so it is reported as PARTIAL. Symbols are never treated as identity.

tools.name: trace_provenance
tools.title: Trace assertion provenance
tools.description: Return a W3C PROV-JSON-shaped provenance graph for one assertion and all of its ancestors in a WWEP 0.1 bundle. Transport such as retrievedVia is recorded as an attribute and never as authority. Offline and read-only.

resources.name: registry-stablecoins
resources.title: Stablecoin deployment registry (record-level verification)
resources.description: Bundled, static registry of stablecoin deployments. Each record carries the authority publication and chain observation it was verified against, with the verification date. Point-in-time; not a safety statement.

resources.name: registry-chains
resources.title: Chain registry (chain IDs observed, finality labels descriptive)
resources.description: Bundled, static registry of supported chains and their finality models.

resources.name: schema-evidence
resources.title: WWEP 0.1 evidence bundle JSON Schema
resources.description: JSON Schema for the WWEP 0.1 evidence bundle accepted by the evidence tools.

resources.name: policies-authority
resources.title: Claim-specific authority policies
resources.description: Bundled authority policies. Authority is defined per claim type; there is no global source ranking.

resources.name: spec-wwep
resources.title: WalletWall Evidence Profile 0.1 (draft)
resources.description: Normative draft text of the WalletWall Evidence Profile 0.1. Not an industry standard.

resources.name: conformance-version
resources.title: Engine, rules and data versions
resources.description: Versions and content digests of the bundled engine, registry, policies, rules and specification.
